purpose: Trace from scenario obligation to observable mechanics in source code

expectedResult.structure: one row per mechanic observed in scenario's callable graph

fields.name: mechanicCount
fields.description: Number of times this mechanic occurs in callable

fields.name: sourceReferences
fields.description: File, line, column of mechanic occurrences

sourceQueries: trace.feature-to-callgraph.v1 (get callables in scenario's entry point)
implementation.traceStrategy: find all callables reachable from scenario's responsibility, extract all mechanics

queryLinearization: SELECT s.scenarioId, r.obligationId, c.callableId, m.mechanicType, COUNT(*) as mechanicCount, ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(m.file, m.line, m.column)) as sourceReferences FROM intent.responsibility-obligation(?) AS r JOIN trace.feature-to-callgraph(r.featureId) AS c JOIN source-facts.mechanics-by-callable(c.callableId) AS m GROUP BY s.scenarioId, r.obligationId, c.callableId, m.mechanicType
reconciliation: all callables must be in scenario's reachable graph
mechanics must be observable in actual source code
source references must be valid lines
typedFailures: MECHANIC_NOT_OBSERVABLE (mechanic claimed but not found in code)
